'''Wayne Lowell Nicholson''' (March 26, 1958 – June 8, 2023) was an American [[Microbiology|microbiologist]].<ref name="a" />

== Life and career ==
Nicholson was born in [[Canton, New York]], the son of Lowell and Ethel Nicholson.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/61048/records/1914499|title=Wayne Lowell Nicholson|publisher=U.S., Presbyterian Church Records, 1701-1970|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Ancestry.com]]}} {{Closed access}} {{Subscription required}}</ref> He attended the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1987.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://microcell.ufl.edu/people/wayne-l-nicholson/|title=Wayne L. Nicholson|work=[[University of Florida]]|access-date=September 17, 2022}}</ref> After earning his degree, he worked as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] at the [[University of Connecticut]] from 1988 to 1991.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://astrobiology.nasa.gov/news/in-memoriam-wayne-lowell-nicholson/|title=In Memoriam: Wayne Lowell Nicholson|work=[[NASA Astrobiology Institute]]|access-date=April 7, 2024}}</ref>

Nicholson served as a professor in the department of [[microbiology]] and [[cell biology]] at the [[University of Florida]] from 2003 to 2023.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://fora.aa.ufl.edu/Provost/IndependentFora/Distinguished-Professors|title=Distinguished Professors/Curators|work=[[University of Florida]]|access-date=September 17, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220528002859/https://fora.aa.ufl.edu/Provost/IndependentFora/Distinguished-Professors|archive-date=May 28, 2022|url-status=live|via=[[Wayback Machine]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://blogs.ifas.ufl.edu/news/2019/11/26/three-uf-ifas-faculty-members-elected-2019-aaas-fellows-largest-number-yet/|title=Three UF/IFAS Faculty Members Elected 2019 AAAS Fellows, Largest Number Yet|work=[[University of Florida]]|date=November 26, 2019|first=Tom|last=Nordlie|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 2019, he was named a [[distinguished professor]],<ref name="a" /> and was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=CA&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=nicholson&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=June 12, 2026}}</ref>

== Death ==
Nicholson died on June 8, 2023, at the age of 65.<ref name="a" />
